title: Eutrophication Workbench Virtual Laboratory (EWB VLab)
description: Machine-readable metadata describing the Eutrophication Workbench workflow, recommended versions, folder layout, and execution steps.

steps.title: Setup the Workflow Folder Structure
steps.purpose: Create local workflow folder structure and copy query notebooks and configuration files from Public/
actions: Copy and run the notebook in /home/jovyan/workspace/<myfolder>
Provide user identifier, time range, and depth range when prompted

steps.title: Access & Harmonise Data with BEACON
steps.purpose: Query the merged BEACON instance and export harmonised EOV datasets
actions: Run the notebook to generate Parquet outputs

steps.title: Detect Duplicates with CW
steps.purpose: Run the CWdt Duplicate Tool to identify duplicate records across BDIs
actions: Launch CW Duplicate Tool in CCP

steps.title: Remove or Annotate Duplicates and Convert with FileForge
steps.purpose: Apply CWdt decisions and convert outputs to ODV or other formats
actions: Select CW outputs and a FileForge YAML config from 3_FileForge/Configuration_files/

steps.title: Explore & Validate (optional)
steps.precondition: FileForge must be run with an ODV configuration (wb2_odv_config.yaml)
actions: Import .txt produced by FileForge into webODV

notes: Latest BEACON merged instance version used: v1.5.4
Workflow starter notebook recommended version: v2.0.0 (exposed as latest)
Use Public/FileForge_config/conf/latest/ for newest FileForge settings or fall back to versioned configs
